thy_essential_multi.name: Essential Multi
thy_essential_multi.key: Per 3 capsules: 100 mcg selenium, 15 mg zinc, 150 mcg iodine, 1,000 IU vitamin D3, 200 mcg B12; no iron
thy_essential_multi.src: Products DB scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R716 (NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by 15 switch-chart label checks): per 3 capsules selenium 100 mcg (Integrative Therapeutics Clinical Nutrients HP, Klaire CORE MULTI and VITAPRIME rows), zinc 15 mg (Pure, DFH, Ortho, Thorne, IT, Klaire rows), iodine 150 mcg (Pure PureGenomics row), vitamin D3 25 mcg = 1,000 IU, B12 as methylcobalamin 200 mcg, folate as L-5-MTHF 800 mcg DFE, iron none (every row); directions 'Take 3 capsules once daily with food'. Sizes R716 90C (30 servings) and R716L 180C, ND144 price list 10/1/26. No verified product-page URL, so the link falls back to catalog search. Photo: only the 160 px chart thumbnail exists (LOW-RES).
